title: Process: a P1-P9 priority scale replaces P0/P1/P2

labels.name: P1
labels.description: Unsafe or wrong output: gouge, collision, wrong G-code, crash, data loss; blocks a cut

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:medium
labels.description: One module or crate, a known pattern (issue-worker-medium)

body:
Decided by the maintainer (question dialog, 2026-11-12): "We might need a P1-P9 prioritization system now.. we're having issues with scope creep throughout the issue list" -> option "P1 to P9 scale: replace P0/P1/P2 with nine levels; agents keep filing and rating their own issues as today". Filed by an agent for him. The level definitions below are the agent's DRAFT for the maintainer to correct in the PR.

**Why.** 185 open issues on 2026-11-12, 156 filed by agents, 65 opened that day. 73 carry `P1`, of which 43 are enhancements (19 EDM, 17 MCP by rule): `P1` no longer separates "a user hits wrong behaviour" from "someone wants this", and three levels cannot order the list.

**Draft scale** (lower number = picked first; `P?` stays "paused by the maintainer, never picked"):

| Label | Means | Examples | Was |
|---|---|---|---|
| `P1` | Unsafe or wrong output: a gouge or collision that passes, wrong posted G-code, a crash, data loss | #1173, #1188, #934 | `P0` |
| `P2` | Main is broken, or a regression in the last release with no workaround: main does not build, a gate on main is red, the app cannot open a project it saved | #1146, #1184 | red-gate `P1`s |
| `P3` | Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround: a legal program refused, a misleading message, a dialog that cannot do what it says | #1174, #1105 | `P1` bugs |
| `P4` | Work the maintainer asked for, for the next cut | #661, #1103, #1104, the EDM chain | `P1` enhancements he opened |
| `P5` | The agent surface and the tooling keep up with what shipped: an MCP tool or skill row for a shipped command, a gate or process fix that blocks contributors | #989, #1059, #1084, #1153 | `P1` MCP / process |
| `P6` | Accepted enhancements, not scheduled | #931, #692's remainder | other `P1` enhancements |
| `P7` | Owed polish and small fixes: wording, layout, a missing test, a refusal that could say more | #1185, #1186 | `P2` bugs and polish |
| `P8` | Larger ideas that need design or research before code | #743, #744, #892, #895 | `P2` enhancements, `effort:max` |
| `P9` | Someday: not picked while anything else is free | - | - |

**Rules that change with it** (each is a line of AGENTS.md today):
- Pick: lowest number first, then oldest; the two lanes and their sizes stay. In the enhancement lane "user-filed first" stays, then the number.
- Safety floor: every `P1` is at least `effort:high` (was: every `P0`).
- A red batch gate on main is filed `P1` if it is wrong output or a gouge, else `P2` (was `P0` / `P1`).
- A minor/major cut does not start while a `P1` or `P2` it opened is unfixed (was: `P0`).
- "Every MCP issue is P1" becomes "every MCP issue is `P5`, unless paused `P?`".
- Filing: an agent sets one `P1`..`P9` by this table (never `P?`); "wanted" is not a reason for `P1`-`P3`, which are for defects only; `P4` is set only where the maintainer asked for the work in his own words (quote them); a follow-up found while working or reviewing is `P7` unless it is a defect.
- `P?` unchanged.

**Migration** (one scripted pass, the minute the PR merges, so no issue ever carries an old and a new meaning at once; open issues only, closed ones keep their history):
1. Create labels `P3`..`P9`; re-describe `P1` and `P2`.
2. Old `P1` first (while "P1" still means the old thing): bugs -> `P3` (red-main ones -> `P2`); enhancements the maintainer asked for (EDM #530-#548 and #617, #661, #1103, #1104, #1089's follow-ups) -> `P4`; `area:mcp` and process -> `P5`; other enhancements -> `P6`.
3. Old `P0` -> `P1`. Then delete the `P0` label.
4. Old `P2`: bugs and polish -> `P7`; enhancements -> `P8` (`P6` where an open PR already works them).
5. The 19 open issues with no priority get one by the table.
6. A comment on #681 with the mapping; the migration list (issue, old, new) is attached to the PR or this issue for audit.

**Files to change:** `AGENTS.md` (Issue Law: Pick, `P?`, lanes, effort safety floor, "Report on the issue", needs-research sub-issues; "Everything Is a Command" MCP rule; "Fixes are tested in the background"), `.claude/skills/gh-issues/` (SKILL.md, `references/claim-workflow.md`, the three evals), `.claude/skills/classify-effort/SKILL.md`, `.claude/skills/work-issue/`, `.claude/skills/review-prs/`, `.claude/agents/*.md`, `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/*.yml` if they name priorities, `README.md` / `CONTRIBUTING.md` if they do. `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` bumped; announced on #681.

Done means: the scale and the changed rules are in AGENTS.md and the skills with no leftover `P0` or old-meaning `P1`/`P2` (a grep in the PR body shows it); the labels exist with one-line descriptions; every open issue carries exactly one of `P1`..`P9` or `P?`; the migration list is recorded; forks are told on #681.
